workLog.action: Read the response header instead of the rate_limit payload, and they contradicted
workLog.detail: At 10:13:48Z gh api rate_limit reported core remaining 4829 of 5000. At 10:15:22Z the header on a refused core call reported remaining 0 and used 5001. Same bucket name, opposite readings, 94 seconds apart. The header put it in exhaustion mode with an 18 minute window, so a short fixed backoff would have failed three times. Recorded in the existing memory rather than a new one.
